description: This file defines the TransactionManager<TState> class, which implements ITransactionManager to handle transaction preparation, commit, and ping operations within Orleans transactions.

classes.name: TransactionManager<TState>
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a transaction, including preparation, commit, and ping responses within Orleans transaction framework.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction, validating locks and updating the transaction record accordingly.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Signals that a participant has prepared for a transaction.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Maintains transaction activity by responding to a ping from participants.
